decisions.reason: The Demeter natural yogurt extends the firm's core organic yogurt expertise and is a flagship of its direction, so its in-house dairy knowledge and R&D let it interpret results and refine the line rather than abandon it.
Mild sliced cheese builds directly on the firm's in-house cheesemaking know-how and is presented on its own page, making it easy to assimilate market feedback and improve.

Sliced butter cheese is close to the established cheese offer and uses existing slicing and packaging capabilities, so related knowledge supports keeping and adapting it despite some risk of portfolio trimming among similar sliced cheeses.
